test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc364eadab0854faddb95be2b30988e98bfd11f5f65f0731d2c03f8a132e2d4a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

The 'parallelogram' is moving in the anticlockwise direction and skips a space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83dc2e71792f15b61ca926ed9d3bc1035f6a79a50d8ffc69f0017823f12847b4.png] 

The 'pound' sign moves in the clockwise direction in each step. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9380a6822c4802840ed507c7f5f03c32748b55237aa771384935fbf8908e7e1e.png] **The "arrow" moves in the clockwise direction and skips two spaces also it tilts in every alternate step.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa86e8fee5b22305455de878a67d205aac26a8670fbf3fea2302e1d2373f0111.png] 

Next step:

"Parallelogram" will be placed at bottom left.

"Arrow" will be placed at bottom center.

"Pound" sign will be placed at top left.

So, the image that complete the series will be: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21e52d492d1ac377f09eeff9f6afc1a4a30af3349209246ae79a293eb7948587.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "option 1".
